units.source_text: 匂皇子在宇治时心绪缭乱，不曾随心所欲地和两位女公子通信，颇有不满之感。

en.t: When Prince Niou was at Uji, his thoughts were in turmoil, and because he had not been able to correspond with the two young ladies as freely as he wished, he felt rather dissatisfied.

units.source_text: 因此回京以后，不烦薰君介绍，常常写信直接送去。

en.t: Therefore, after returning to the capital, he no longer troubled Kaoru to act as intermediary, but often wrote letters and sent them directly.

units.source_text: 八亲王看了他的信，对侍女们说：“回信还是要写的。

en.t: After Prince Hachi read his letter, he said to the ladies-in-waiting, "A reply should still be written.

units.source_text: 但不可当作情书对付，否则反而引起将来烦恼。

en.t: But it must not be treated as a love letter, or it will only bring trouble in the future.

units.source_text: 这位亲王想是很爱风流的人，听见这里有这两个小姐，不肯放过，便写这些信来开玩笑吧。”

en.t: This prince must be a man who greatly enjoys romantic elegance; hearing that these two young ladies are here, he cannot let the matter pass and is probably sending these letters in jest."

units.source_text: 他劝女儿写回信，二女公子便遵命写了。

en.t: He urged his daughters to write a reply, and the younger lady obeyed and wrote one.

units.source_text: 大女公子非常谨慎小心，对于此种色情之事，即使逢场作戏，也决不肯过问。

en.t: The elder lady was extremely cautious and reserved, and when it came to such amorous matters, she would never involve herself, even as a passing game.

units.source_text: 八亲王一直度送孤独的生涯。

en.t: Prince Hachi had long lived a lonely life.

units.source_text: 春日迟迟，更觉寂寞无聊，常恨日长难暮，愁思越来越多。

en.t: The lingering spring days made him feel still more lonely and weary; he often resented how long the days were and how slowly evening came, and his melancholy thoughts grew ever more numerous.

units.source_text: 两位女公子年龄越长，姿色越增，竟变成了两个绝色美人。

en.t: As the two young ladies grew older, their beauty increased, until they had become two women of surpassing loveliness.

units.source_text: 这反教八亲王增加痛苦，他想：“倒不如长得丑些，

en.t: This only increased Prince Hachi's anguish, and he thought, "It would have been better if they had grown up somewhat plain,

units.source_text: 那么埋没在这山乡里也不大可惜，我的痛苦或可减少些。”

en.t: for then it would not be such a pity for them to remain buried in this mountain village, and my suffering might be somewhat lessened."
Because of this, he worried day and night.

units.source_text: 此时大女公子二十五岁，二女公子二十三岁。

en.t: At this time, the elder young lady was twenty-five, and the younger young lady was twenty-three.
